description:
Perform automated particle tracking on a 5D microscopy hyperstack using the TrackMate plugin.

Your goal is to track the movement of dividing nuclei/chromosomes in the provided sample image:

1. Open the image at `~/Fiji_Data/raw/tracking/mitosis.tif`. This is a 5D hyperstack (2 channels, 5 Z-slices, 51 time points).
2. Pre-process the image:
   - Split the channels (`Image > Color > Split Channels`) and identify the channel containing the chromosomes (blobs).
   - Create a Max Intensity Z-Projection of the chromosome channel to flatten it to 2D+Time (`Image > Stacks > Z Project...`).
3. Launch `Plugins > Tracking > TrackMate` on the projected image.
4. Configure the tracking pipeline:
   - Detector: LoG (Laplacian of Gaussian) or DoG detector.
   - Estimated blob diameter: ~8.0 microns (approx 15-20 pixels).
   - Threshold: Adjust until chromosomes are detected (approx 2.0-5.0).
   - Tracker: Simple LAP tracker.
   - Linking max distance: 10.0 microns.
   - Gap-closing max distance: 10.0 microns, Max frame gap: 2.
5. Complete the wizard to generate tracks.
6. Export results:
   - Save the track statistics (Spots or Tracks table) to `~/Fiji_Data/results/tracking/track_statistics.csv`.
   - Save a visual overlay image (screenshot or Capture Overlay) showing the tracks on the cells to `~/Fiji_Data/results/tracking/tracks_visual.png`.
